Standard: Each fire zone includes features to shut-off all flammable fluids and de-energize all electrical ignition sources entering the fire zone in the event of a fire during all ground and flight operations. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Inspect design documents to show shut-off valves are present that will prevent flammable fluids or vapors from entering the fire zone during a fire.
(2) Inspect design documents to show all electrical ignition sources in the fire zone are able to be de-energized during a fire. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct analysis to show the activation of fluid shut-off or electrical isolation for one fire zone does not adversely affect any remaining propulsions systems, if present. Test.
    (1) Ground test: Conduct ground tests to show all flammable fluid or vapor lines to a fire zone are able to be closed without causing any additional hazard or adversely impacting any additional propulsion systems, if present.
    (2) Ground test: Conduct ground tests to show all electrical equipment in the fire zone are able to be de-energized in the event of a fire without causing any additional hazard.
